canonical_source.behavior: When Href is absent, AppButton renders a real button with the configured type/title, native disabled behavior, aria-busy and aria-pressed state, and dispatches the supplied OnClick callback. Busy state renders a spinner while retaining the button content.

laravel_adaptation.runtime_consumer: none required for the shared component contract
laravel_adaptation.behavior: The production React AppButton renders a native non-link button, preserves type/title/aria-label/aria-busy/aria-pressed, relies on native disabled click suppression, dispatches the supplied React click callback, and supports a consumer-specific canonicalOperationId while retaining the shared component identity as data-canonical-component-operation. Existing terminal consumers are intentionally left unchanged.

authorization.reason: This shared control dispatches an already-authorized consumer callback and does not grant permissions, select a tenant, or call a backend endpoint by itself.

tenant_isolation.proof: The component accepts no tenant or resource identifier and constructs no route.

degraded_and_retry_semantics.busy: aria-busy is exposed without fabricating success.
degraded_and_retry_semantics.retry: No internal retry is performed; the consumer owns retry/idempotency semantics.

acceptance_tests.coverage: exact canonical marker, native button/type/title, OnClick dispatch, disabled suppression, busy/pressed accessibility, and separation of consumer versus shared-component canonical identity
regression guard proving the pre-existing terminal Runtime Error Recover control remains unchanged, locally recovers without navigation/network mutation, and fails safely on recurrence

terminality.basis: Source-equivalent non-link AppButton behavior is implemented as a production React shared component and covered by deterministic focused acceptance while existing terminal controls remain unchanged; no authority, persistence, or route semantics are added.
